params.name: marker
params.description: The value that you specified for the marker parameter in the request to get the next page of results.

params.name: maxitems
params.description: The maximum number of hosted zones to include in the response body.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of the public and private hosted zones that are associated with the current AWS account.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 Create a hosted zone

items.docs: Creates a new public or private hosted zone. When you create a hosted zone, Route 53 automatically creates a default SOA record and four NS records for the zone.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 Get hosted zone details

params.name: Id
params.description: The ID of the hosted zone to retrieve.

items.docs: Gets information about a specified hosted zone including the four name servers assigned to the hosted zone.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 Delete a hosted zone

params.name: Id
params.description: The ID of the hosted zone to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a hosted zone. You can delete a hosted zone only if it contains only the default SOA record and NS resource record sets.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 List resource record sets

params.name: Id
params.description: The ID of the hosted zone that contains the resource record sets.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of resource record set to begin the record listing from.

params.name: name
params.description: The first name in the lexicographic ordering of resource record sets to list.

params.name: maxitems
params.description: The maximum number of records to include in the response.

items.docs: Lists the resource record sets in a specified hosted zone.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 Create, update, or delete resource record sets

params.name: Id
params.description: The ID of the hosted zone that contains the resource record sets.

items.docs: Creates, changes, or deletes a resource record set, which contains authoritative DNS information for a specified domain name or subdomain.

params.name: marker
params.description: The value to use for the marker parameter in a subsequent request.

params.name: maxitems
params.description: The maximum number of health checks to include in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of the health checks that are associated with the current AWS account.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 Create a health check

items.docs: Creates a new health check that monitors the health and performance of your web applications, web servers, and other resources.

info.name: Amazon Route 53 Get health check details

params.name: HealthCheckId
params.description: The ID of the health check to retrieve.

items.docs: Gets information about a specified health check.
